title: Source or remove every number on the zedu.chat marketing pages
description:
Execute the accepted workstream's register. Every numeric/outcome claim on the live marketing pages, each mapped to its source file:line on cybertron-integration: homepage stats 10,000+/15,000+/98% (Herosection.tsx:6-8); feature stats 3x/40%/24-7 (featureSectionData.ts:53-64); price ₦20,000 (pricingData.ts:50); solutions pages bootcamps 50%/2x/40%, schools 50%/2x/65%, universities 40%/2x/60% (bootcamps/page.tsx:114-122, schools/page.tsx:114-122, universities/page.tsx:136-144); footer badges (footer/index.tsx:120,128).

Work: (1) for each number, either add its sourced basis in the same PR or remove/soften it; (2) fix the two pricing contradictions — ₦20,000 vs ₦20K on the same page, and 'Starter' on the card vs 'Basic' in the comparison table; (3) re-crawl the site to verify the rendered result; (4) deliver a per-number decision table (kept+sourced / softened / removed) with reasons. Same evidence format as the approved seed-terms delivery.

goal.title: Give every number on the marketing site a source, by Fri 4 Dec
goal.description: /solutions/bootcamps claims 50%, 2x and 40%; /solutions/universities claims 40%, 2x and 60%; /solutions/schools claims 50%, 2x and 65%. None carries a source, a sample or a date, and each page is under 450 words. Build one register of every quantitative claim on the public site: the exact wording, the page, what would prove it, and a supported or unsupported verdict. Then either attach the evidence or remove the number. No new statistic may be added without an entry.
